question: In a certain code language, PACIFY is written as KUXCUS and MERIT is written as NYICG. How will INSULT be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**The Logic followed is;

**The Odd Number Place letter is coded as reverse letter and Even Number Place letter is decreased by 6.**

**Odd Number Place means Place 1, Place 2 not the positional letter values count as even and odd.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

According to the English alphabet series and its positional value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1196a07d03c9f02e7bec22cfc36a195fd3a58e076da25a1e2a394b79aea80ec7.png] 

The logic follows here is:

**The odd number places letters are coded by reverse positional letters and the even number places are decreased by 6.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/067f0c25caf11251473dfede94b58a0518f8c86e8ccb817d67559610c4ddca82.png] 

And;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2c23dd48421bfd5d346885df0949fb01f4c70fb4e32f5efe0eb0d4613fc561d.png] 

Similarly;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b567fe24cd9f3a7db9e491496ec37c997adc9ac5b0625c4cc478f1727b61d5ea.png] 

Hence, **"RHHOON"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Shortcut to remember the reverse positional letters.
